jobs.title: Software Engineer / AI Code Trainer (Python, Web, Full Stack)
jobs.location: USA, UK, India, Australia, Ireland, New Zealand, Philippines, Pakistan, Singapore, Mexico
jobs.raw_description: Who Should Apply We are looking for developers from all technical backgrounds and language specializations. If you write clean code and understand software design, you are a fit: Software Engineers & Computer Scientists specializing in algorithms, data structures, or system design. Full-Stack & Web Developers working with modern front-end or back-end frameworks (JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, PHP, Ruby, etc.). Backend & Systems Developers experienced in languages such as C++, Java, Go, Rust, or Python. DevOps & Database Engineers familiar with API design, SQL/NoSQL databases, or scripting. Role & Responsibilities As an AI Code Trainer , you will evaluate model-generated code, author reference solutions, and stress-test AI reasoning across various engineering domains. Code Auditing & Quality Analysis: Critique AI-generated solutions for logic, performance, security vulnerabilities, syntax, and coding best practices. Gold-Standard Solutions: Write clean, production-grade reference code and clear technical explanations for complex programming prompts. Test Design: Build unit tests and edge-case scenarios to evaluate model accuracy and expose edge-case failures. Technical Feedback: Write structured explanations detailing why an AI solution succeeds, fails, or produces bugs. Requirements Software Engineering Proficiency: Strong core fundamentals in at least one major programming language or web stack (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C++, Go, C#, Rust, PHP). Debugging & Code Review: Ability to quickly analyze third-party code, catch subtle logical errors, and evaluate efficiency. Technical Communication: Clear written English to explain technical concepts and code review rationales effectively. Eligible Locations: Resident of USA, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India, Pakistan, or Philippines . Why Join Us? $50–$125/hr commensurate with your technical domain expertise and task complexity. Weekly Guaranteed Payouts directly to your choice of PayPal or Payoneer . 100% Remote & Asynchronous: Total schedule control—work whenever and wherever you choose with no fixed minimum hours. How to Apply Apply directly on our website at https://codeforai.tech/

Our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights. The world's top investment funds and Fortune 500 companies depend on our data to drive high-stakes decisions. We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. What It's Like to Work Here: Ownership is real, not aspirational. An analyst here can own a data product end-to-end - from methodology to client delivery - and present directly to the investors who depend on it. You won't spend months waiting for "meaningful work." Growth is driven by impact , not tenure. Scope and responsibility expand as fast as you can demonstrate you're ready. We promote based on what you've done, not how long you've been here. AI is a core working tool, not a side project. We're actively rebuilding how analytical work gets done - using AI agents, automation, and new tooling to fundamentally change what's possible. If you're excited about that, you'll thrive here. About the Role: YipitData's Central Data team sits at the foundation of everything we deliver. Central Data exists to identify those common patterns and build shared solutions that improve quality, consistency, and speed across the company. This is a highly analytical product ownership role that combines deep data expertise, systems thinking, technical leadership, and cross-functional execution.
